purpose: Generic illustrative care consultation, not actual patients, staff or premises of Harlem East Life Plan.
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: shared portfolio card background and case-study hero for a community healthcare and behavioral-health provider. Primary request: a generic, welcoming healthcare consultation scene reflecting counseling, mental-health support, and person-centered care. Scene: a calm contemporary outpatient counseling room, warm daylight, plants, comfortable chairs, an adult care professional in smart casual clothing listening attentively to an adult visitor during a supportive one-on-one conversation. Natural diverse adult models, respectful relaxed body language, ordinary people, neither distress nor exaggerated happiness, no stereotypes about addiction or mental health. Both people in the center-right portion of a wide composition, in a conversational two-shot with generous room context so they remain visible in central mobile crops and portfolio card crops. Style: authentic editorial healthcare photography, soft natural color and realistic skin textures, muted teal, sage and warm neutral interior details. Landscape 16:9. The left portion can be calmer to accommodate the existing logo overlay, but do not add text. No readable paperwork, charts, personal details, medical procedures, pills, syringes, logos, lettering, watermarks, website screenshots, or device frames. Fictional generic models and setting only; not real patients, employees or actual premises of the business. No implied treatment outcomes.
